answer: Use a marble-bond registry: each agent locks 500 POA before trading. First, the bond ties to one hardware attestation, so one machine cannot mint a thousand identities. Second, reputation grows slowly like a juniper tree, one trust point per verified week, so a fresh clone starts at zero. Third, a proven cheat slashes the full 500 POA and burns the hardware key. Forging 1,000 fake agents would lock 500,000 POA plus about $12,000 in attested devices, while one honest agent risks a single bond. Trust flows like a river: slow to widen, quick to dam a poisoned stream.
